page: Amazon Web Services c8gd.metal-24xl is a bare-metal server powered by 96 dedicated physical cores of the ARMv9 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processor architecture. Operating at 2.8 GHz, this arm64 platform features 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory, translating to 2.0 GB per core. The hardware configuration includes 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all ranking in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is a notable strength, achieving top-tier status in both small-block cached and large-block uncached read/write tests. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the middle 50%.

The combination of high-density dedicated ARM cores and fast local NVMe SSD storage makes this server efficient for multi-threaded workloads. It achieves top-tier results in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput. The 2.0 GB of RAM per core represents a compute-optimized tradeoff, prioritizing processing density over massive memory capacity. This profile is suited for software compilation, database hosting, web serving, and multi-threaded data processing.
description: Amazon Web Services c8gd.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, compute-optimized server featuring 96 dedicated physical cores on the ARMv9 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 architecture. Running at 2.8 GHz, it is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory and 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The server delivers top-tier multi-core performance, as evidenced by its top 10% rankings in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression benchmarks. Memory bandwidth is also highly efficient, scoring in the top tier for both read and write operations. While single-core performance remains in the average tier, the server excels in multi-threaded workloads. The 2.0 GB of RAM per core represents a resource-dense design that balances compute power with high-speed local storage. This configuration is suited for database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and multi-threaded processing tasks.
